case.pattern_description: Coordinated multi-card device sharing syndicate: Device profile (Unknown | Unknown | chrome 66.0 | Unknown) was utilized across 171 distinct customer accounts in a synchronized timeframe, frequently routing via anonymous proxy infrastructure (Proxy IP).

evidence.claim: Device profile is shared across 170 other cardholders (C00027-K1, C00036-K1, C00073-K2, C00259-K1)
Cardholder C13171 submitted formal dispute stating: 'Customer C13171 message: 'I never made this $55.68 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3558054.'

case.summary: Coordinated fraud syndicate identified across multiple cardholders sharing device profile Unknown | Unknown | chrome 66.0 | Unknown. Multi-hop graph traversal linked transaction 3558054 on C13171-K2 with 170 additional compromised cards routing via anonymous proxy infrastructure. Recommended card block, regulatory SAR filing, and monitoring connected cards per Policy R6 and R9.

sar.reason: Policy Rule R6 and R9: Coordinated syndicate utilizing shared device across multiple cardholders.
sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) documents unauthorized credit card fraud identified on customer account C13171. On 2016-12-19 22:08:56, flagged transaction 3558054 for $55.68 was detected via online channel with an elevated risk score of nan. Graph analytics and multi-hop link expansion revealed that the transaction was associated with device profile 'Unknown | Unknown | chrome 66.0 | Unknown', which was identified across 170 additional cardholder accounts (C00027-K1, C00036-K1, C00073-K2). The cardholder, when contacted for transaction validation, confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of their physical card. The activity exhibits characteristics consistent with undocumented, where compromised credentials or card data were systematically exploited. Total cumulative fraudulent exposure across identified affected transactions (3558054) totals $55.68. The financial institution has taken immediate mitigating actions by blocking card C13171-K2 for reissue, opening internal case HHG-008 in graph memory, and placing all connected card accounts under continuous surveillance per Bank Policy R2, R6, and regulatory guidelines.

stop_reason: Cardholder dispute confirmed unauthorized transaction. Evidence sufficient for definitive blocking and case creation.
